data.title: Ethereum staking queue holds over 1.17 million ... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's validator entry queue currently holds about 1.17 million ETH waiting to become active validators, with an estimated wait time nearing 21 days. This queue size is about 14% lower than the previous snapshot from October 23. Validators must stake at least 32 ETH to join, and the queue reflects the amount of ETH waiting for activation, not the number of stakers or market sentiment. Overall, 44.3 million ETH is staked, representing 36.22% of the total supply, with an annual reward rate of 2.44%.
